quote: Preceded in the series by GPT-4, it was launched on August 7, 2025.
note: Lab (OpenAI) and kind (shipped) notes confirmed. The date is from the Wikipedia article, which also gives August 7, 2025 in the infobox and says GPT-5 was unveiled in a livestream on August 7. The system card index page (openai.com/index/gpt-5-system-card/) and a search snippet describe it as dated August 7, 2025; the canonical system card PDF is labeled August 13, 2025 after an update. OpenAI's launch page (openai.com/index/introducing-gpt-5/) returned HTTP 403 to WebFetch, so the OpenAI primary source was not read directly; the quote is from a summarizing fetch of the Wikipedia page, not verified against raw text. One non-primary article (aivancity.ai) gives August 20 as the unveiling date; most sources say August 7. Before launch, some American companies (e.g. Oscar Health, Uber, BBVA) reportedly had pre-release access. That is private early access, not a public preview, so preview_date is null.
queries: OpenAI GPT-5 released publicly date announcement
